handoffs.message: Helper-claimed by Codex while Claude completes higher-priority work.

Implemented persistent JSONL crawl frontier with queued/running/done/failed/retry state, bounded run-scheduled worker, DLQ replay -> frontier replay, robots/allowlist/max-bytes/max-records/timeout guards, compose scheduler service, and one-shot scheduler script. Verification: python3 -m compileall -q services/source_ingestion scripts/source_ingest_scheduler_once.py; python3 -m pytest services/source_ingestion -q (43 passed); docker compose config --quiet; git diff --check.

Review approved: all 5 acceptance criteria met. Persistent JSONL frontier with full state machine, durable watermarks/backoff/DLQ replay, robots/allowlist/max-bytes/max-records/timeout enforcement, service and bounded worker modes, 43 tests passing. Returning to Codex for closeout.
